messages:
alex: incident-bot just paged about a spike of 5xxs out of eu-west-1. looks tied to the new canary variant v2-quant and routing fallback churn. starting thread here

incident-bot: PAGER: smart-routing.producer | eu-west-1 | high error rate | metric: 5xx_rate > 4% over 5m | cause hint: canary v2-quant failing healthchecks; multiple fallback attempts observed

maria: grabbing oncall. @sre_oncall are we looking infra or model? can you pull recent traces?

sre_oncall: looking now. early signals: v2-quant returns 503 for some long inputs (>1024 tokens). infra shows a few canary pods OOMKilled, but not cluster-wide.

maria: can we pause rollout immediately in console to stop traffic to v2-quant?

product_cust: pausing now — setting canary traffic to 0% and switching fallback to non-sticky. applying change.

ops_tier2: note: current active routing policy has sticky_affinity=true with TTL=24h for that rollout. that will cause users to be re-routed to the canary after fallback. looks like route bounce.

jin: traces confirm: request -> v2-quant (503) -> fallback -> affinity cookie set by gateway -> subsequent requests routed back to v2-quant. loop persists due to long TTL.

alex: quick mitigation plan: 1) disable sticky affinity on rollout policy 2) evict existing affinity sessions 3) scale canary pods to 0 4) add temporary rule to ignore affinity for unhealthy variants

maria: patching policy now: sticky_affinity=false for rollout id r-7c9b. will evict sessions after policy update.

maria: evict via admin API:
```
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/admin/evict-sessions" -d '{"policy_id":"r-7c9b","variant":"v2-quant"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

sre_oncall: scaling down canary pods
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy canary-v2-quant --replicas=0
```

ops_tier2: adding temporary rule: ignore affinity headers if variant.health==unhealthy for 15m. rule id tmp-ignore-8812 deployed.

incident-bot: CONFIG-CHANGE: routing rule tmp-ignore-8812 applied by ops_tier2

customer-success: we already have 4 support tickets from EU tenants reporting intermittent embedding failures. labeled sev=medium. affected accounts: acct-42, acct-77, acct-103, acct-212.

maria: customer impact estimate: ~0.6% of eu-west-1 traffic affected, concentrated on long-sequence embedding batches. notifying CS and account owners.

product_cust: confirmed rollout paused, sticky affinity cleared, sessions evicted, canary scaled -> 0. monitoring shows 5xx rate decreasing.

jin: monitoring traces — 5xx rate in eu-west-1 fell from 5.1% to 0.7% over two 5m windows after mitigations. no new loop patterns seen.

alex: good. immediate action items from this call:
- remediation complete: rollout paused, affinity disabled, sessions evicted, canary removed from pool
- suspected root cause: model regression in v2-quant for long token inputs combined with an unsafe routing policy (sticky_affinity TTL too long for a canary)
- follow-ups: add pre-rollout validation to reject sticky_affinity=true for canaries, implement affinity-evict in runbooks, add short-loop detection alert, add model input shape checks in runtime guardrails

sre_oncall: taking a 2h watch window to ensure no recur. will hand off to @jin afterwards. suppressing noisy alerts from tmp-ignore-8812 while we stabilize.

product_cust: filing hotfix ticket: "routing: prevent sticky affinity on canary rollouts" assigned to release and infra squads, attaching traces and config diffs. cc @maria

customer-success: sent mitigation emails to affected accounts with a short summary and ETA for postmortem. requested to open a follow-up call if errors persist.

maria: drafting incident doc and timeline. will include commands, metrics, and recommended policy changes. assigning postmortem owners to infra + runtime.

alex: we will close pager after three consecutive 5m windows <1% 5xx in eu-west-1.

jin: three consecutive windows reached, confirming stable. leaving a note: added a gating test to the canary pipeline to reject sticky TTL > 1h for canaries.

incident-bot: INCIDENT-RESOLVE: smart-routing.producer | eu-west-1 | mitigated | summary: canary paused, affinity evicted, temporary ignore-affinity rule applied

maria: handing to @sre_oncall for 2h watch. will post postmortem draft to #postmortems when ready.

sre_oncall: acknowledged. capturing logs and will attach to postmortem doc.

alex: thanks all. follow-ups for infra (policy validation), runtime (input guards), devex (runbook), cs (customer comms). :thumbsup:
